## Circular to Certain Deemed Licensed Corporations - Sole Proprietors

## Migration into the New Regime under the Securities and Futures Ordinance

As you are aware, the two-year transitional period for licensees registered under the former regime to migrate into the new regime will end on 31 March 2005.  There are only about 7 months left before the expiry of the transitional period.  However, we note that you have yet to submit your migration application.

Please  be  reminded  that  if  you  fail  to  lodge  your  application  by  the  end  of  the transitional  period,  your  existing  licence  to  conduct  regulated  activities  will  cease  to have effect.

Under  the  new  regime,  only  corporations  may  be  licensed,  as  principal,  to  carry  on businesses  in  regulated  activities.    Furthermore,  the  Securities  and  Futures  Ordinance provides that at least two individuals have to be approved by the SFC as responsible officers of a corporation in respect of each type of regulated activity the corporation is licensed for. Therefore, as a sole proprietor, you are required to incorporate your business and look for at least  one  extra  competent  individual  to  become  a  responsible  officer  supervising  your business under the new regime.  To avoid business interruption and last minute rush, we urge you take immediate action to prepare for a smooth transition.

For more information, please refer to the Guidelines on Transitional Arrangements and the sample of completed migration application forms available on the SFC website 1 .    You may also contact the Intermediaries Relationship Manager responsible for your firm should you wish to discuss further on migration matters.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission

1. The Guidelines on Transitional Arrangements can be downloaded from http://www.hksfc.org.hk/eng/licensing/html/intermediaries/guidelines\_on\_transitional\_arrangements\_eng .pdf.

Sample completed migration application forms can be downloaded from http://www.hksfc.org.hk/eng/licensing/html/LIC\_Sample\_Forms/migration\_sample\_eng.tif
